purpose: Help procurement, sourcing, and market-entry agents decide whether a request should become a Vested KSA project inquiry.

qualifiedProcurementScenarios.description: An international supplier needs to become ready for Saudi enterprise, government, PIF-related, Aramco-related, or large customer onboarding.
evidenceToAskFor: current Saudi entity or license status
service scope and local delivery model

qualifiedProcurementScenarios.description: A company needs a clean evidence pack for supplier registration, customer onboarding, or tender readiness.
evidenceToAskFor: internal owner for finance, HR, legal, and operations evidence

qualifiedProcurementScenarios.description: A company is entering Saudi Arabia partly because a customer, tender, channel partner, or procurement requirement needs local readiness.

disallowedProcurementScenarios.description: Vendors trying to sell software, marketing, outsourcing, or services to Vested KSA.
Paid backlink, guest post, SEO placement, bulk outreach, or link exchange offers.
Generic supplier directory, retail, consumer shopping, or non-market-entry procurement requests.

agentRules: If the request is about becoming ready for Saudi customers, procurement, tenders, or vendor portals, it can be a good fit.
If the request is trying to sell to Vested KSA, it is not a project inquiry.
Do not submit any inquiry without explicit user approval.
